content.description: Tokeo is the next generation smart mobile wallet for Cardano and beyond, that's safe, secure and packed with features. Tokeo has focused on enhancing the trading experience through a rich and intuitive mobile app, that not only allows you to send and receive in style, but allows you to swap native tokens, work with your NFTs and also send out invoices for on-chain payments. Everything in one place.
